title: Operations
learning_outcomes: Explain process mapping in the context of operations.
Compare and distinguish capacity and throughput in the context of operations.
Apply controls in the context of operations.
Evaluate and justify decisions about improvement metrics in the context of operations.

lessons.title: Process mapping
lessons.outcome: Explain process mapping in the context of operations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving process mapping; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to process improvement proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain process mapping from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of process mapping; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Capacity and throughput
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish capacity and throughput in the context of operations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving capacity and throughput; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to process improvement proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain capacity and throughput from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of capacity and throughput; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Controls
lessons.outcome: Apply controls in the context of operations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving controls; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to process improvement proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain controls from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of controls; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Improvement metrics
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about improvement metrics in the context of operations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving improvement metrics; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to process improvement proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain improvement metrics from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of improvement metrics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of process mapping; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of capacity and throughput; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of controls; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of improvement metrics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
